target:
for slide in 4 7 8 9 11 12 13 17 19 21 23; do
  count=$(unzip -p /tmp/Frontier_Partner_JT_Filled.pptx ppt/slides/slide${slide}.xml 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,re; c=sys.stdin.read(); print(len(re.findall(r'E8620A.*?<a:t>', c)))")
  remaining=$(unzip -p /tmp/Frontier_Partner_JT_Filled.pptx ppt/slides/slide${slide}.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'Enter text here' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  echo "Slide $slide: $count orange runs, $remaining unfilled"
done
